scene_analysis.scene_overview: A city street view of a white car parked on the side of a street in front of a large building with many windows and balconies. The car is facing away from the camera and has a black roof. There are two trees on either side of the car, and a sidewalk in between them. A small black structure is on the corner of the building behind the car. The building has a beige facade with a few windows and doors. The ground floor has a few shops and restaurants. The street is paved with asphalt and has a white line painted down the middle. The sky is blue and clear.
